column1: # The descriptions of built-in functions, written for this server, one line each. A line names a
# function, the dialects it is for (`*` for all four), and optionally the parameters (as in the data
# files, overloads separated by ` | `), the type it returns and the description. Parameters are
# only given where the server reports none or names them poorly; a function the server's catalog
# does not list (a form of the grammar) must have them.
